Page 1646 
Sotyktu (deucravacitinib) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-589219  
Guideline Name 
Sotyktu (deucravacitinib)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Sotyktu  
Diagnosis 
Plaque Psoriasis (PsO)  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims confirming 
ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis (PsO)  


=== PDF PAGE 1647 ===
Page 1647 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Greater than or equal to 3% body surface area involvement, palmoplantar, facial, or 
genital involvement, or severe scalp psoriasis  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 History of failure to one of the following topical therapies, unless contraindicated or 
clinically significant adverse effects are experienced:  
• 
corticosteroids (e.g., betamethasone, clobetasol)  
• 
vitamin D analogs (e.g., calcitriol, calcipotriene)  
• 
tazarotene  
• 
calcineurin inhibitors (e.g., tacrolimus, pimecrolimus)  
 
AND 
 
 1.4 History of failure of a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within 
the last 6 months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are 
experienced  
 
AND 
 
 1.5 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the following topical therapies:  
• 
Vtama  
• 
Zoryve 0.3% cream  
 
AND 
 
 1.6 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
A preferred adalimumab biosimilar or Enbrel (etanercept)  
• 
Infliximab  
• 
Otezla (apremilast)  
• 
A preferred ustekinumab biosimilar  


=== PDF PAGE 1648 ===
Page 1648 
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a dermatologist  
 
AND 
 
3 - Not used in combination with other potent immunosuppressants (e.g., azathioprine, 
cyclosporine, biologic DMARDs)*  
Notes  
*Sotyktu may be used with concomitant methotrexate, topical or inhal
ed corticosteroids, and/or low stable dosages of oral corticosteroids. 
 
Product Name:Sotyktu  
Diagnosis 
Plaque Psoriasis (PsO)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming positive clinical response to 
therapy as evidenced by ONE of the following:  
• 
Reduction the body surface area (BSA) involvement from baseline  
• 
Improvement in symptoms (e.g., pruritus, inflammation) from baseline  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a dermatologist  
 
AND 
 
3 - Not used in combination with other potent immunosuppressants (e.g., azathioprine, 
cyclosporine, biologic DMARDs)*  


=== PDF PAGE 1649 ===
Page 1649 
Notes  
*Sotyktu may be used with concomitant methotrexate, topical or inhal
ed corticosteroids, and/or low stable dosages of oral corticosteroids. 
 
Product Name:Sotyktu  
Diagnosis 
Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA)  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or verification of paid claims confirming 
ALL of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of active psoriatic arthritis (PsA)  
 
AND 
 
 1.2 One of the following:  
• 
Actively inflamed joints  
• 
Dactylitis  
• 
Enthesitis  
• 
Axial disease  
• 
Active skin and/or nail involvement  
 
AND 
 
 1.3 History of failure of a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within 
the last 6 months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are 
experienced  
 
AND 
 
 1.4 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
A preferred adalimumab biosimilar or Enbrel (etanercept)  


=== PDF PAGE 1650 ===
Page 1650 
• 
Infliximab  
• 
Orencia (abatacept)  
• 
Otezla (apremilast)  
• 
Xeljanz (tofacitinib) oral tablet (IR or XR)  
• 
A preferred ustekinumab biosimilar  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Dermatologist  
• 
Rheumatologist  
 
AND 
 
3 - Not used in combination with other potent immunosuppressants (e.g., azathioprine, 
cyclosporine, biologic DMARDs)*  
Notes  
*Sotyktu may be used with concomitant methotrexate, topical or inhal
ed corticosteroids, and/or low stable dosages of oral corticosteroids. 
 
Product Name:Sotyktu  
Diagnosis 
Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming positive clinical response to 
therapy as evidenced by at least ONE of the following:  
• 
Reduction in the total active (swollen and tender) joint count from baseline  
• 
Improvement in symptoms (e.g., pain, stiffness, pruritus, inflammation) from baseline  
• 
Reduction in the body surface area (BSA) involvement from baseline  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 1651 ===
Page 1651 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Dermatologist  
• 
Rheumatologist  
 
AND 
 
3 - Not used in combination with other potent immunosuppressants (e.g., azathioprine, 
cyclosporine, biologic DMARDs)*  
Notes  
*Sotyktu may be used with concomitant methotrexate, topical or inhal
ed corticosteroids, and/or low stable dosages of oral corticosteroids.

Date  
Notes

Added criteria for new PsA indication, updated DMARD criterion and 
note throughout.
